Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075104. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return the first 1000 rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
